## Problem / 问题

Describe the trigger and the incorrect behavior.

## Change / 修改

Describe the resulting behavior. For routes, state the gate order, entry/exit
faces and wrapping side; screenshots alone are not a substitute for these.

## Validation / 验证

List the checks you ran and any relevant limits, including simulator flight
validation when applicable. For UI changes, check both English and Chinese.

## Source and privacy / 来源与隐私

required notices. Include no credentials, private images/tracks, databases or
proprietary simulator assets.
